correctness.rationale: The unit-coefficient nilpotent locus is explicitly a graph over G_m x A^(p-2) by the inverse-residue criterion; all other nilpotents are I_2. The centralizer formulas are verified from triangular coefficient elimination over arbitrary fields of characteristic p>=5. For centralizers that are high-valuation nonabelian ideals, a separate complete valuation-stratified commuting-pair calculation is made, and Grothendieck classes are summed. This proves the exact motivic identity, not just experimental point counts. The checker independently exhausts p=q=5 triple counts and selected ideal-pair counts at p=5,7. Limit: reduced underlying varieties only.

value.rationale: The exact reduced Grothendieck class of the natural restricted-nilpotent commuting triple variety refines component/dimension geometry in a way that detects all finite-extension point counts and its rational Hasse–Weil zeta function. The formula is uniform in all prime characteristics p>=5 and arbitrary base fields of that characteristic; it is a natural arithmetic invariant connected to the Frobenius-kernel support-variety motivation in the older Witt literature. The result is not a free-parameter slice or a finite-table recomputation; its key ingredient is a stratification by all nilpotent first entries, including the nonabelian centralizer ideals.
